scope: Paginated/incremental PR+issue inventory of24 configured repositories plus bounded review of21 selected active forks; relevant cards/comments/file diffs and changed-source comparisons. Not every file/PR/fork semantically audited.

reviewed.decision: Included official YuE2 progress/estimate improvement; existing media parameters preserved.
Included F16-to-F32-to-BF16 compatibility lowering in Audio.cpp Vulkan paths, not a new BF16 hardware capability.
Included official Anthropic tool_choice auto/any behavior and upstream regression test source; daily inference not run.
Read GCN async-readback corruption report and targeted opt-out; R9 390/Gemma4 evidence is not RX580/Qwen evidence. Do not force global async-off or legacy noAVX2 flags.

Reviewed fresh comments and relevant diff: MOSS position/modulation/layout reuse and Wan grouped decode are promising; large pending SD API refactor not copied wholesale. Preserve working Pro latent-only ABI/legacy photo cache behavior.
IQK activation quantization uses iqk_quantize_any and fused up-gate implementation absent in current KCPP backend; no blind port of 1% claim.

Pool1d row parallelism candidate confirmed; KCPP has a different general padded-kernel implementation, not the upstream specialized sk-p0 kernel. Deferred separate geometry/correctness port, not imported by textual replacement.
Async MoE cache uses CUDA provider/MMVQ interfaces; not a drop-in Vulkan cache. Preserve existing opt-in HybridMoE.
FMA introduces GGML operation plus backend/graph integration; no enum/ABI transplant from monolithic IQK tree.
Random media marker fix belongs to ik server/Jinja/mtmd context absent in KCPP server; no unrelated marker port.
Changed files are documentation; no new Haswell/Polaris kernel.
Reviewed scale-count loader and LFM/Clover graph changes; Strix/FPX model-specific support does not fix Windows Polaris HIP. Not ported into unrelated loaders.
Notebook/bench experiments for Maya and high-end CUDA machines; no transferable measured Haswell/RX580 patch.

speed: No scheduled benchmarks or inference. Speed effect of new upstream changes unmeasured.
release_summary: Official update: [YuE2 progress estimates](https://github.com/LostRuins/koboldcpp/commit/f7eb772d08ea7a592f7693d2cc065ce3bfb97860), [Vulkan-safe BF16 audio casts](https://github.com/LostRuins/koboldcpp/commit/f0d781bf11c93c3cb2be42f1330fcd7d6748705d), Qwen3-TTS/Breeze/Ming/NeuTTS integration and [Anthropic tool_choice fix](https://github.com/LostRuins/koboldcpp/pull/2571). Existing Ray/YuE2/Pro media recipes are preserved. No new speed claim. Local build fix: emit the new Qwen3TTSSession destructor out of line to resolve GCC13/MinGW LTO duplicate thunks; LTO stays enabled.
local_fix: Extended existing GCC13/MinGW out-of-line virtual-destructor port to new upstream Qwen3TTSSession after actual LTO COMDAT/thunk duplicate definitions. Keeps mandatory LTO and implicit destructor ABI; no new speed claim.
local_media_gui: Optional Media launcher tab and --media/--no-browser; standalone core requires separately installed portable media runtime.
